info.title: Ride2View HTTP API
info.description: Source-anchored documentation of the current Ride2View Node.js API. This contract is non-invasive: no routes are renamed or version-prefixed. Some payloads remain intentionally opaque until validated against authority schemas. External services are not implicitly activated. API-02 adds verified core typed schemas and live HTTP fixture checks without changing operational authority.

cookieAuth.name: r2v_session
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly SameSite session cookie. Not applicable to public and signed callback operations.

providerSignature.name: x-provider-signature
providerSignature.description: Verified by the configured payment provider adapter. May be unavailable when the provider is not configured.

gatewayHmac.name: x-r2v-signature
gatewayHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 of x-r2v-timestamp + '.' + raw request body; timestamp freshness enforced by server.

OpaqueJsonObject.description: Legacy/domain payload not yet fully typed; consult the authoritative server module. Do not use as blanket runtime validation.

LegacyRegistrationRequest.description: Only available when verified-registration enforcement is disabled. Returns 410 in production.

ManualPaymentVerificationRequest.description: Admin-only; payment amount must be an exact integer KES amount and match the payable record; reference uniqueness and atomic reservation confirmation remain server-enforced.

AuthChallengeRequestEmail.description: Existing email contacts only require email; first-time registration also requires name and password. Enforcement is conditional in server/auth/onboarding.js.

AuthChallengeRequestPhone.description: Kenyan phone number is normalized by the OTP module. Name and role are optional for existing contacts.

AuthChallengeResponse.description: The six-digit code is never returned in this response.

AccountIdentity.description: Session identity. verified is the current SQLite integer flag (0 or 1), not a boolean.

latitude.description: Absent coordinates are normalized by the opportunity model to null; a supplied coordinate pair is validated by server/validation.js.

longitude.description: Absent coordinates are normalized by the opportunity model to null; a supplied coordinate pair is validated by server/validation.js.

source.description: The canonical opportunity model uses null when a location source is unavailable; supplied coordinates are marked agent-supplied.

price.description: Server coerces price with Number() and requires a positive safe-integer KES amount.

bedrooms.description: Server coerces bedroom values using Number().
Legacy top-level bedroom alternative, supported by the server.

ListingCreateRequest.description: Property.bedrooms or top-level bedrooms is required. Server normalizes numeric strings and validates coordinates, price and duration; this schema documents canonical fields without changing those coercion rules.

ListingPatchRequest.description: Partial listing update. `approved` cannot be set through this endpoint; publication review is separate.

PropertySlotCreateRequest.description: Both times must be in the future, have explicit UTC offsets, and define a positive slot of at most 24 hours; overlaps return 409.

ViewingRequestCreateRequest.description: Tier defaults to general. Requires signed-in customer, published verified listing, qualifying preferences and available slot. Idempotent same-key replay returns HTTP 200.

ViewingRequestRecord.description: Raw request row from creation; a replay may add duplicate=true. Payload and linked booking details are intentionally not asserted.

CustomerPreferencesUpdate.description: PUT replaces the provided preference fields (not a merge with previously saved preferences), matching the existing implementation.

JourneyCreateRequest.description: The server requires qualifying property slots, customer details, route feasibility and participant eligibility. maxStops/maxParticipants also depend on active administrative policy.

JourneyPlan.description: Agents receive a redacted plan without participants/contact information.

ViewingJourney.description: Response projection differs by role. Agent responses redact plan contact/participants and payment/quote information. Lifecycle fields are intentionally open for state-machine compatibility.

PropertyListingSnapshot.description: Stored listing payload snapshot embedded in viewings, bookings and journey stops. Unlike a public listing projection, it does not include live verification, media or publication flags.
